# Changelog

All notable changes are listed here. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and versions follow
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-16

First public release.

### Added
- Segmented downloads over up to 8 connections, with pause, resume, retries,
  a queue, a speed limit, proxy and site-login support.
- A macOS app with a menu bar icon, banners and sounds, launch at login and a
  setting to keep the Mac awake while downloading.
- A Chrome and Firefox extension that hands browser downloads to the app,
  with a "Download with Haul" link menu and lists that follow the app's
  Settings.
- A user guide in Settings, About, Help.
- Update notifications: once a day (optional) Haul checks GitHub for a newer
  version and shows what's new, with a button that downloads the new DMG.
